\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 190-193 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R198-first-pass-words-from-chapters-190-193}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for against and around.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to copy, to hide, to press, to knead, to cool
  \item to scatter, to row, to melt, to part, to point
  \item the face, the body, the throat, the thigh, the waist
  \item an accident, jealousy, shyness, pride, wonder
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To copy? (\textbf{\ml{പകർത്തുക}}, \emph{pakarttuka}.) To hide? (\textbf{\ml{ഒളിക്കുക}}, \emph{oḷikkuka}.) To press? (\textbf{\ml{ഞെക്കുക}}, \emph{ñekkuka}.) To knead? (\textbf{\ml{കുഴയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{kuḻaykkuka}.) To cool? (\textbf{\ml{ആറ്റുക}}, \emph{āṟṟuka}.) To scatter? (\textbf{\ml{ചിതറുക}}, \emph{citaṟuka}.) To row? (\textbf{\ml{തുഴയുക}}, \emph{tuḻayuka}.) To melt? (\textbf{\ml{ഉരുകുക}}, \emph{urukuka}.) To part? (\textbf{\ml{പിരിയുക}}, \emph{piriyuka}.) To point? (\textbf{\ml{ചൂണ്ടുക}}, \emph{cūṇṭuka}.) The face? (\textbf{\ml{മുഖം}}, \emph{mukhaṁ}.) The body? (\textbf{\ml{ശരീരം}}, \emph{śarīraṁ}.) The throat? (\textbf{\ml{തൊണ്ട}}, \emph{toṇṭa}.) The thigh? (\textbf{\ml{തുട}}, \emph{tuṭa}.) The waist? (\textbf{\ml{അര}}, \emph{ara}.) An accident? (\textbf{\ml{അപകടം}}, \emph{apakaṭaṁ}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{\ml{അസൂയ}}, \emph{asūya}.) Shyness? (\textbf{\ml{നാണം}}, \emph{nāṇaṁ}.) Pride? (\textbf{\ml{അഭിമാനം}}, \emph{abhimānaṁ}.) Wonder? (\textbf{\ml{അത്ഭുതം}}, \emph{atbhutaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 194-198 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R198-second-pass-words-from-chapters-194-198}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for childbirth and a surgical operation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item childbirth, a surgical operation, hearing, health, an eyelid
  \item every day, a date, the weekend, quickly, in advance
  \item so far, still, finally, on time, free time
  \item a pharmacy, a clothes shop, on the left, on the right, straight ahead
  \item south, east, west, against, around
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Childbirth? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രസവം}}, \emph{prasavaṁ}.) A surgical operation? (\textbf{\ml{ഓപ്പറേഷൻ}}, \emph{ōppaṟēṣan}.) Hearing? (\textbf{\ml{കേൾവി}}, \emph{kēḷvi}.) Health? (\textbf{\ml{ആരോഗ്യം}}, \emph{ārōgyaṁ}.) An eyelid? (\textbf{\ml{കൺപോള}}, \emph{kaṇpōḷa}.) Every day? (\textbf{\ml{എന്നും}}, \emph{ennuṁ}.) A date? (\textbf{\ml{തീയതി}}, \emph{tīyati}.) The weekend? (\textbf{\ml{വാരാന്ത്യം}}, \emph{vārāntyaṁ}.) Quickly? (\textbf{\ml{പെട്ടെന്ന്}}, \emph{peṭṭennŭ}.) In advance? (\textbf{\ml{മുൻകൂട്ടി}}, \emph{munkūṭṭi}.) So far? (\textbf{\ml{ഇതുവരെ}}, \emph{ituvare}.) Still? (\textbf{\ml{ഇപ്പോഴും}}, \emph{ippōḻuṁ}.) Finally? (\textbf{\ml{ഒടുവിൽ}}, \emph{oṭuvil}.) On time? (\textbf{\ml{കൃത്യസമയത്ത്}}, \emph{kṛtyasamayattŭ}.) Free time? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴിവുസമയം}}, \emph{oḻivusamayaṁ}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{\ml{മരുന്നുകട}}, \emph{marunnukaṭa}.) A clothes shop? (\textbf{\ml{തുണിക്കട}}, \emph{tuṇikkaṭa}.) On the left? (\textbf{\ml{ഇടത്ത്}}, \emph{iṭattŭ}.) On the right? (\textbf{\ml{വലത്ത്}}, \emph{valattŭ}.) Straight ahead? (\textbf{\ml{നേരെ}}, \emph{nēre}.) South? (\textbf{\ml{തെക്ക്}}, \emph{tekkŭ}.) East? (\textbf{\ml{കിഴക്ക്}}, \emph{kiḻakkŭ}.) West? (\textbf{\ml{പടിഞ്ഞാറ്}}, \emph{paṭiññāṟŭ}.) Against? (\textbf{\ml{എതിരെ}}, \emph{etire}.) Around? (\textbf{\ml{ചുറ്റും}}, \emph{cuṟṟuṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
